warnings: This set prints grid bubbles 1-11 (x) and A-F (y) on the structural plans S-01..S-03. Origin = A1 (A is the topmost named row).

Rows A/B and E/F are printed as two bubbles only 0.125 m apart: the outer chain prints A-C 3.625 and D-F 2.525, the inner chain B-C 3.50 and D-E 2.40, on every structural plan (S-01 twice, S-02 twice, S-03) — five drawings agree, so A = B - 0.125 and F = E + 0.125. Columns/footings sit on B, C, D, E (the inner chain); A and F are the outer edge lines.

Before-origin dummies hang off row B (the inner chain they are printed on): A' -3.875 (4.00 on the F1 beam plan; by scale this tick measures ~3.75 m, printed value taken), A'' -1.925 (roof plan 2.05), A''' -1.375 (F1 beam plan 1.50 overhang), A'''' -0.875 (F2/F3 plans 1.00). After F, dummies hang off row E: F' 10.525 (1.00, F2/F3), F'' 11.025 (1.50, F1 plan and รูปตัด ข), F''' 11.575 (2.05 roof), F'''' 11.795 (2.27, F2 plan), F''''' 12.025 (2.50, รูปตัด ก).

The building sections (รูปตัด ก/ข, p10) label the two column lines 7.00 apart as A and D (section ก prints bubbles A, B, D, E) — the plans call the same lines B and D (B-D = 3.50 + 3.50). Plans win (op01 precedence 1); the section chains are recorded against the plan names.

z: รูปตัด ก closes (0.85 + 3.50 + 3.50 + 3.00 = +10.85). รูปตัด ข prints classroom floors +4.45 / +7.95 and ระดับท้องคาน +10.85 but its top segment is printed 3.00 although +7.95 to +10.85 is 2.90 — it matches the corridor level +7.85 instead. Recorded as printed. Ground-floor corridor: +0.85 (section ก) vs +0.80 (section ข) — both recorded.

Swept: structural plans S-01..S-03 (p19-p21), building sections p10, floor plans p06 (แปลนพื้นชั้น 1 / ชั้นที่ 2). Its 3.50 | 1.00 | 2.00 entrance chain confirms 3' 9.50 / 4' 13.00 / 4'' 14.00 from a second sheet. Left unswept on 2026-10-19 (computer scheduled shutdown 23:43): p07 (floor 3 + roof plan), p08-p09 (elevations), p11-p16 (stair/detail/door/wall sheets) and the stair-sheet dimensions on S-09 — all swept on 2026-10-23, together with p03, p17-p18 and S-10 (see the 2026-10-23 warnings below).

Core/stair-bay lines (printed with leading dashes, read as tick marks): the S-02 stair chains '-1.90 | 2.25' (F3) and '-2.65 | 1.50' (F2) both total 4.15 and only meet the B4 stair beam when measured from row A (the outer line), so they are taken from A: B' 1.90, B''''' 2.65, C'' 4.15. The '-0.52' printed below row C on both floors gives C + 0.52 = 4.145 — 5 mm from C'' and the same B4 edge printed twice; both kept as lines (C' 4.145, C'' 4.15) per section 4 rule 4, B4 recorded on C''. S-01 '-2.00' (G2) taken from A as well = B'' 2.00; '-2.15' from C = C''''' 5.775 (B4A).

Classroom joists (B1, bays 2-3 to 9-10, all three floors) sit at two unprinted positions between B and D: by scale they divide the 7.00 B-D bay into thirds (measured B+2.41 / B+4.73 / B+7.03 on S-01, the third on row D). B'''' 2.458 and C'''' 4.792 = B + 7.00/3 and B + 2 x 7.00/3, position scaled from the grid (section 4 span amendment); each line carries its own 0.6 score.

Sweep 2026-10-23 (op04 pending item): A-03 p07 (roof + floor-3 plans), A-04/A-05 p08-p09 (four elevations), p11 stair sheet, p12 toilet/railing/eave sheet, p13 door ป1, p14 window น, p15 board/partition wall, p16 septic tank, S-09 p27 stairs. With p06/p10/S-01..S-03 swept on 2026-10-19 the dimension sweep now covers every sheet that prints grid-axis rows or levels (p01-p05 cover/title/material, p17-p18 electrical and the element sections S-04..S-08 / S-10 were not swept: their numbers live on the elements).

A-03 roof plan and floor-3 plan repeat the structural rows exactly (x 2.05 | 10 x 4.00 | 2.05, total 40.00; y 2.05 eave / 1.00 slab edge off B and E, 3.50 | 3.50 | 2.40, outer 3.625 / 2.525). No new line.

Elevations p08/p09 print no dimension row, only level labels: ระดับพื้นชั้นล่าง +0.95, ระดับพื้นชั้น 2 +4.45, ระดับพื้นชั้น 3 +7.95, ระดับหลังคาน / ระดับท้องคาน +11.45, ระดับดินถม +0.00. CONFLICT with the sections p10 (ground floor +0.85, roof-beam soffit +10.85). Decision: nothing moved, the elevation values are added as their own z_levels (ระดับท้องคาน now names two levels). The sections are trusted for geometry because their z rows are dimensioned and close (0.85 + 3.50 + 3.50 + 3.00 = 10.85); the elevations read as a uniform 3.50-storey drawing (0.95 + 3 x 3.50 = 11.45), probably left from before the ปรับปรุง revision. Risk accepted: if the elevations are the newer sheet the ground floor is 0.10 higher and the roof 0.60 higher; no element of this house carries level_m, so no extracted number depends on it.

Stair sheet p11 (section A) prints the corridor at +0.80 / +4.30 / +7.80 (0.80 + 20R@0.175 + 20R@0.175); section ก and A-03 print +0.85 / +4.35 / +7.85; section ข prints +0.80 for the ground corridor. Recorded as printed under the same labels (a label may name two levels); 0.05 apart, not resolved (likely finish vs structure).

p11 stair sheet prints ONE row bubble 'A' through the column centres with A-C 3.50 and C-D 3.50 (= plan B-C, C-D); stair section A prints A/B/D with 3.50 | 3.50 | 7.00 (= plan B/C/D, the same mapping the master already uses for the p10 sections). Every stair row on p11 starts on that tick, so it is taken from plan B: B+1.90 = 2.025, B+2.65 = 2.775, B+4.15 = 4.275 (three new dummy lines) and B+5.65 = 5.775, exactly the existing S-01 B4A line. CONFLICT with S-02, where the same '~1.90 | 2.25' and '~2.65 | 1.50' rows were taken from the outer row A (0.125 lower) so they meet B4 at 4.15 (S-02 also prints 0.52 below C = 4.145). Decision: the structural sheet is kept for the beams (B4 stays on the S-02 line 4.15, nothing existing moved); the p11 ticks are recorded as their own lines 0.125 off. Every stair run on both sheets is printed with '~' (approximate), so the 0.125 sits inside the drawing's own tolerance. The 2.025 tick is 0.025 from the G2 line 2.00; both kept (section 4 rule 4).

p12 toilet detail prints ONE row bubble 'A' with A-C 3.63 — plan A-C 3.625 rounded, so on this sheet the bubble is plan A (the opposite of p11). Its '~2.00' to the toilet front partition lands on the existing G2 line 2.00 from A. Each detail sheet is read by its own printed chain; the two detail sheets disagree on which of the two 0.125-apart lines their single bubble is.

S-09 p27 stair rows have no bubble and run between beam faces (B4A / B4), so they are recorded as floating ('edge') chains; the stair geometry is positioned by the plan rows above. Printed arithmetic slips kept as printed: '7@0.175 =1.235' (7 x 0.175 = 1.225) and ST1 ช่วงล่าง ชั้น 2 '12@0.25 =2.25' (2.25 = 9 x 0.25; the floor 2-3 plan prints 9T).

Detail sheets p12-p16 (railing, grab bars, eave, door, window, partition wall, septic tank) print only element dimensions and an unnamed 4.00 / 8.00 bay; no bubble ties them to a bay, so they are in unassigned_dimensions, one entry per printed row.
op_fix/gridfix: y tick at 2.025 is within 0.05 m of existing ["B''"] but not the same point -- kept both (section 4 rule 4)

op_fix/gridfix 2026-09-29: dummy primes re-sequenced into reading order (spec section 4 Dummy grid) -- B''' -> B'''', B'''' -> B''''', C''' -> C'''', C'''' -> C'''''; grid refs in every file of the house follow; the two older warnings that named these lines (core/stair-bay lines, classroom joists) were rewritten to the new names on 2026-10-23

KEY PLAN p03 is the 9-classroom variant: 8 bays x 4.00 (no total printed, = 32.00), 3 classrooms a floor, stairs at both ends, y 3.50 | 3.50 (7.00) | 2.40. Cover p02 says the 9-room building 'โดยใช้แบบ สปช. 2/28 ปรับปรุง 3 ชั้น 12 ห้อง เป็นต้นแบบ'; every other sheet (p06-p28, title blocks 'อาคารเรียน 3 ชั้น 12 ห้องเรียน') draws the 12-room building, 10 bays x 4.00 = 40.00, which is what this master and every extracted element describe. Key-plan rows are recorded floating ('edge', no bubbles). Its side elevation prints level labels without values (nothing to add to z_levels).

Electrical plans E-01/E-02 (p17-p18, floors 1-3) repeat the structural inner rows exactly (x 10 x 4.00 = 40.00 plus 1.50 ends on floor 1; y 1.00 / 1.50 edges off B and E, 3.50 | 3.50 | 2.40) but print the outer chain as A-C 3.58 (3.57 on floor 1) and D-F 2.48 against the structural 3.625 / 2.525 printed on five structural plans, A-03 and the floor plans. CONFLICT: decision — structural kept (A = B - 0.125, F = E + 0.125 unchanged), the electrical rows recorded as printed between the A/C and D/F bubbles; they do not close against the lines (0.045 off) and are marked by gridfix below. Likely the electrical sheets put the outer line on a thinner wall face (B - 0.075 / E + 0.075); not a structural sheet, so not trusted for position.

Checked and found no grid-axis dimension row: p01/p02/p04 (covers), p05 A-01 (sheet index + material table; block / tile sizes are material specs, not rows). The E-02 installation notes on p18 state mounting heights in prose; not transcribed.
